dedupe_keys.name: tanzania health facility registry hfr portal 14 354 operating health facilities of mainland tanzania by type ownership and region

description: The Health Facility Registry is the Tanzanian Ministry of Health's master list of health facilities on the mainland, published through a public portal. The portal read on 2026-09-28 counts 14,354 operating facilities, from the national hospital, six super-specialised, zonal and regional referral hospitals and 183 district hospitals down to 1,441 health centres, 9,016 dispensaries, 1,125 clinics, 1,918 laboratories and 109 nursing and maternity homes. Charts break the list down by facility type, by owner, including the ministry, local government, military, police, prisons, faith-based and private for-profit providers, and by region, and a panel counts facilities added or updated this month, in the last three months and this year. The menu offers facility search and a download section. Coverage is mainland Tanzania; Zanzibar is not included in the counts read. Access is free; no licence is stated, and the download format and attributes, such as coordinates, were not checked. Caveats: records depend on facility registration and updates, and operating status can lag. It supports hazard exposure and service planning studies, such as overlaying dispensaries and hospitals with flood zones or travel time to the nearest referral hospital. Related record: the Mtwara neonatal care unit survey.
